  "decisions": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Name is HaulOut / haul out / family sentence with Detangler. Domain haulout.dev.",
      "rationale": "Frozen in SPEC §1. Do not reopen.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "ChatRescue",
        "Offthread",
        "Castoff",
        "Offing",
        "Unthread",
        "Ripcord",
        "Omni-exporter"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Primary vehicle is a Tampermonkey userscript. Bookmarklet/console are fallbacks. No HaulOut server.",
      "rationale": "Must run in the page origin with the user's cookies. Same-origin fetch only.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Chrome Web Store extension",
        "Hosted proxy",
        "CLI-first"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Markdown + JSON only in v1. Filename haulout-YYYY-MM-DD-<platform>-<slug>.",
      "rationale": "Readable, diffable, Obsidian/Detangler-friendly. YAML front matter on Markdown.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["PDF", "DOCX", "HTML"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Scope is the open conversation, not a bulk archive. No telemetry.",
      "rationale": "Official takeouts already exist. Local-only is the product promise.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Full-account scrape", "Cloud sync"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D5",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Site is FilePress static on haulout.dev. LocalSlip lease haulout-site:5198. LocalHelm enroll haulout. pnpm.",
      "rationale": "House standard stack. One page is enough for v1. No PocketBase — nothing to persist in a backend.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["SvelteKit app", "Plain install.html only", "PocketBase"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D6",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Repo layout: haulout.user.js at root; fallback/; docs/; examples/; site/; scripts/.",
      "rationale": "GitHub raw and Greasy Fork need a stable root userscript path. Root was a flat dump.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["userscript/ folder (breaks raw URL)", "site-as-repo-root"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D7",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Detangler is the next tool, not a HaulOut mode.",
      "rationale": "SPEC §15. Family sentence only.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Summarize-on-export", "In-script rewrite"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D8",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-03",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Prune Phase 2 CRUD/PocketBase and Phase 7 auth/payment exit criteria.",
      "rationale": "Local-only userscript + static site. Archetype is product but persistence is A-local.",
      "alternatives_considered": ["Keep full Default-A stack"]
    }
  ],
  "gotchas": [
    {
      "date": "2026-09-14",
      "phase": "2-scaffolding",
      "issue": "FilePress ship failed: nav/footer href /#install, but the home heading was Install (supported path), so rehype-slug never emitted id=install. SvelteKit prerender handleMissingId aborted the build.",
      "fix": "Heading is ## Install so the hash matches. Keep nav anchors in lockstep with heading text."
    },
    {
      "date": "2026-09-09",
      "phase": "4-feature-iteration",
      "issue": "Gemini DOM haul duplicated every turn: selectors matched both user-query and nested user-query-content (and model-response / message-content). Chrome headings 'You said' / truncated previews also survived into Markdown.",
      "fix": "Keep outermost nodes only, read the inner content node, strip said-headings, drop truncated preview blocks, dedupe adjacent same-role turns. v1.1.3."
    },
    {
      "date": "2026-09-17",
      "phase": "4-feature-iteration",
      "issue": "Haul out missing on x.com/i/grok?conversation= until a hard refresh. @match was /i/grok* so Tampermonkey never injected after X SPA navigation from the timeline.",
      "fix": "Match x.com/* and twitter.com/*; keep shouldShow() gated to Grok routes. v1.1.4."
    }
  ],
